description: This file contains an Angular component for a notes management page, including logic for displaying, editing, creating, deleting notes, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: NotesPage
classes.description: An Angular component class managing a list of notes, including creation, deletion, selection, editing, and display logic.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches notes from the NotesService based on the current query, updating the notes list and total count.

methods.name: onQuery
methods.description: Handles updates to the search query, setting the internal query signal.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Handles note selection, setting the selected note and opening the editor.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves a note, either updating an existing note or creating a new one, updating the notes list accordingly.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note via the NotesService and updates the notes list, also unselecting if the deleted note was selected.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners when the component is destroyed.
